VALIDATE::protocol
Description
This command allows you to validate payload (traffic) to match given
classification application. Returns TRUE in case of match, FALSE
otherwise.
Note: the APM / AFM / PEM license is required for functionality to
work.
Syntax
VALIDATE
::
protocol
CLASSIFY_APP_NAME
ANY_CHARS
Examples
when
CLIENT_ACCEPTED
{
TCP
::
collect
32
}
when
CLIENT_DATA
{
if
{
[
VALIDATE
::
protocol
http
[
TCP
::
payload
32
]
]
}
{
pool
web_servers
}
else
{
pool
xyz_servers
}
TCP
::
release
}
